extensionDescription.message: A web manager built for project research. Add scattered pages into projects, organize them, and keep working through them.

commandSavePage.message: Add the current page to LaterOn

commandSaveTabGroup.message: Add all pages in the current tab group to LaterOn

commandSaveSelectedTabs.message: Add all selected tabs in the current window to LaterOn

commandSaveAllTabs.message: Add every tab in the current window to LaterOn
